description: General commercial invoice extraction for vendor invoices. Extracts vendor name, invoice dates, invoice number, PO or job reference, GST amounts, total amount, service address, and operational routing fields.

vendor_name.description: Name of the company, supplier, contractor, utility, tradesperson, or vendor requesting payment. Usually appears in the invoice header, logo area, remittance section, or supplier contact block. Do not return the customer, bill-to party, property owner, or payer.

invoice_date.description: Date the invoice was issued. May be labeled Invoice Date, Date, Billing Date, Issue Date, Tax Invoice Date, or Statement Date. Return the date printed on the invoice, not the payment due date, service date, or delivery date.

payment_due_date.description: Date payment is due. May be labeled Due Date, Payment Due, Payable By, Due On, Balance Due Date, or Terms Due Date. Return only an explicitly stated payment due date. If only terms such as Net 30 are shown and no due date is printed, return null.

invoice_number.description: Unique invoice identifier assigned by the vendor. May be labeled Invoice #, Invoice No., Inv No., Tax Invoice No., Bill Number, Document Number, Reference Number, or Ref. Do not return a PO number, job number, account number, customer number, quote number, or work order number unless it is explicitly the invoice number.

job_number.description: Purchase order, job, work order, project, site reference, or reference number associated with the invoice. May be labeled PO #, P.O. No., Purchase Order, Job #, Job No., Work Order, WO, Project No., Project, Site Ref, Customer Ref, or Reference. If both PO and Job numbers exist, return both separated by a semicolon. Return null if no PO, job, work order, project, or reference number is present.

gst_amount.description: Goods and Services Tax amount charged on the invoice. GST is goods and services tax in Canada and it is 5%. May be labeled GST, G.S.T., Goods and Services Tax, GST/HST or Tax Amount. Return the numeric tax amount shown, not the tax rate. If separate GST and PST lines appear, return only the GST amount. If only one combined GST/HST/tax line is shown, return that tax amount. Return null if no GST or tax amount is stated.

total_invoice_amount.description: Final invoice amount due including GST and all charges. May be labeled Total, Invoice Total, Amount Due, Balance Due, Total Due, Grand Total, Please Pay, or Amount Payable. Prefer the amount the customer is expected to pay. Do not return subtotal or amount before tax.

service_address.description: Address where the work, service, delivery, utility, repair, job, or property-related service was performed. May be labeled Service Address, Service Location, Site Address, Job Address, Work Location, Property Address, Premises, Installation Address, Ship To, or Service For. Do not return the vendor address. Do not return the billing address unless no separate service/site address exists and the billing address is clearly the serviced property.

is_handwritten.description: Classify as yes if the document contains handwritten text for any of the following key fields: vendor name, invoice number, invoice date, payment due date, PO or job number, amounts, GST, total invoice amount, service address, or line item descriptions. Indicators of handwriting include inconsistent letter casing within a single word, irregular character spacing, words that appear written rather than typed, or text that a human clearly wrote by hand rather than computer printed. Also classify as yes if the document is a pre-printed template form where blanks have been filled in by hand. Classify as no only if all key fields are entirely printed or digitally generated with consistent font rendering throughout. When in doubt, classify as yes.

vendor_category.description: Categorise the vendor as one of the listed values based on the type of goods or services provided on the invoice. Use utilities for electricity, gas, water, waste, telecom, or similar services. Use landscaping for lawn, grounds, tree, irrigation, or snow services. Use trades for construction, repair, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, restoration, or other skilled trade services. Use other when none of the categories clearly apply.

anomaly_flag.description: Note anything unusual about this invoice: missing critical fields, invoice number absent, payment due date absent, service address absent, GST/total arithmetic inconsistent, suspiciously round amounts with no itemisation, vendor name not matching the service region, duplicate-looking line items, or invoice total lower than GST. Return an empty string if nothing unusual is detected.
